question: What is said in the essence protection rite?
premises: In essence protection rite thus, emanation triad is said.
In heart lotus sheath middle, those two collision is desired.
inference: The essence protection rite says the emanation triad is the desired collision of two in the heart lotus sheath.
plain_english: In essence protection rite thus, emanation triad is said; in heart lotus sheath middle, those two collision is desired.
